pass_condition:
For EVERY seed in {0,1,2}:
  exact_match_looped > exact_match_baseline
AND mean_over_seeds(exact_match_looped - exact_match_baseline) >= 0.10 (at least a 10 percentage-point mean gap on 4-digit addition).
status_rule: PASS if the pass_condition holds. PARTIAL if mean(looped) > mean(baseline) but the every-seed strict win or the 10pp mean-gap fails. FAIL otherwise (including ties or baseline ahead on mean).
